subject: Coaching plan & next steps for Dylan Brooks
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coaching plan & next steps for Dylan Brooks

Dylan —

Thanks for taking the time to meet last week. I wanted to follow up with a concise coaching plan so we both have the same expectations over the next six weeks. This is an informal, documented coaching path intended to get you back on track before any formal steps.

Summary of concerns
- Missed quarterly delivery goals (Q4 -> Q1 rollover)
- Repeatedly late handoffs to QA leading to rework
- Less proactive communication on blockers with the feature team

Proposed coaching steps (starting today):
1) Weekly 1:1 cadence focused on concrete deliverables and blockers (Wednesdays, 30 min)
2) Explicit success criteria for each sprint task assigned to you (owner, acceptance, estimated time)
3) Shadowing/check-ins: pair with Marissa for release process on two stories this cycle
4) Mid-point review after 3 weeks with tangible evidence (tickets closed, on-time handoffs)

Immediate asks
- Please confirm you can attend the weekly Wednesday 09:30 1:1.
- By EOD Tuesday, send a prioritized list of your next six tasks with owners/estimates.

I've attached a short coaching plan and a template for the 1:1 notes. This is meant to be constructive — we want to support you with clearer structure and measurable progress.

Attachment: coaching_plan_20270215.pdf (application/pdf, 68KB)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Edge Product
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coaching plan & next steps for Dylan Brooks

Thanks, Soojin —

I appreciate the clarity and the structure. I can make Wednesdays at 09:30 for the weekly 1:1. I'll send the prioritized task list by EOD Tuesday.

Quick context: two of the high-priority items slipped because I was unblocked but waiting on infra config approvals — I should have escalated earlier. I'll include those details in the task list and set clear owners for each handoff.

Thanks for the guidance — I want to get back on track.

— Dylan

Good 1:1 today. Appreciate you walking through the ticket breakdown. I've attached my notes from today's meeting and highlighted three immediate actions we expect you to complete by next Friday:

- Reassign outstanding infra approvals and confirm owner by EOD Thursday
- Complete and submit the Feature QA checklist for ticket #RD-412 by Tuesday
- Pair with Marissa on the release process for RD-419 and RD-420 (schedule set)

We agreed the mid-point check will be Monday, 1 Mar 2027. At that time we will review the artifacts and make a joint decision about whether to continue the informal coaching plan or transition to a formal PIP process if insufficient progress is shown.

Attachment: 1on1_notes_20270222.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 24KB)

Thanks both for keeping documentation tidy on this. A couple of HR notes to make sure the process is compliant and fair: 

1) Document retention: Please save all 1:1 notes, meeting agendas, and artifacts to the HR folder (link: https://notion.redwood.ai/people/dylan-coaching-notes) so they’re discoverable should we need to escalate.
2) Formal escalation window: If the mid-point review (today) shows less than 50% of agreed actions completed and no clear remediation plan, we will move to a formal PIP template within 5 business days. That PIP would include clear measurable outcomes and a 30-day improvement window.
3) Reasonable accommodations: If there are context items (medical, personal, or onboarding gaps) Dylan wants HR to be aware of, please reply to me directly and I’ll keep the details confidential.

Dylan — please acknowledge receipt. If you prefer I join the remaining 1:1s for additional support, let me know and I’ll coordinate calendar invites.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
